rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=6, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, n_iter=400, outer_wall_s=1200, lr=0.0023, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=5, proj_kernel=7, img_kernel=5, proj_sx=1.0, proj_sy=2.0, proj_sr=0.02, img_sx=1.5, img_sy=1.5, img_sr=0.02, rationale=iter-3: ONE knob changed vs iter-2 (img_n_bf 3->5); all 18 other fields held IDENTICAL to demo_dl_dual_domain_bilateral_n2i_iter_02.json. Trajectory: iter-1 img_n_bf=1 -> val 0.6657 / hr +0.2763; iter-2 img_n_bf=3 -> val 0.7465 / hr +0.3276 (+0.081 SSIM, +0.63 dB PSNR). The image-domain capacity lever is the WORKING lever (proj side is in the symmetry trap per the design doc: proj sigmas near-identity -> stacked proj BFs stay locked-symmetric, so proj_n_bf stays 1). Keep exploiting the proven lever one notch further: deepen the image-domain bilateral cascade 3->5. Per solver_dual_ddomain_bilateral_n2i.md, the image-domain stack readily differentiates into a multi-scale cascade (BF1 mild + tight sigma_r, BF2 wider, BF3 widest); two MORE BFs give the cascade two additional scales (coarse-to-fine edge-preserving), growing the image denoiser from 9 to 15 trainable scalars (total network 12->18, still ultra-low, far too few to memorise 6 val scenes). Chose DEPTH over kernel/sigma because depth is the proven lever here (+0.08 with one notch 1->3) whereas a kernel/sigma tweak would be a less-informed guess. Held fixed: proj_n_bf=1, kernels (proj_k=7/img_k=5), all six sigma inits (proj 1.0/2.0/0.02, img 1.5/1.5/0.02), lr=2.3e-3, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, n_iter=400, train_n=200, val_n=6, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42 (-> identical val split, directly comparable to iter-1/iter-2). Wall: iter-2 ran 175 s; two more image-domain BFs add only a small fraction of the 128-view FBP+proj per-step cost, so comfortably under the 1800 s sbatch wall and the 1200 s outer_wall_s internal guard. Hypothesis: a 5-deep image-domain cascade adds coarse+fine scales beyond the 3-deep cascade, lifting val_score above iter-2 0.7465. If it does NOT move val_score (or regresses), the image-domain BF depth has hit its structural ceiling on this dense phantom substrate and iter-4 should pivot from DEPTH to img kernel (img_k 5->7) or img sigma tuning.
